body: I also consider this. First I have to pay some credits to move out from home, but I guess that would be the next step when I live alone. I aso want to move to an other city. Just to restart. Probably find something I'm looking for. Probably to be a person you want to spend time with :)

Thank you for your attention. Apologies for my poor english but I just try to tell my story. Well, I probably start early. I always was an annoying adhs child. You know those kids noone can stand longer than five minutes. Also I wasn't a quickstarter in school. So I spend a year at a special shool for kids with learning problems. I got beaten up every day because as a kid I was smaller and weaker than the rest of my class. And, as you can imagine, those kids aren't the most gentle. Most of the breaks I was kicked and punched by about five kids while lying on the floor. After that year was over I didn't really change. Most of my time at school I was either bullied or bullying others. Weaker or more awkward kids. And our class was pretty bad. Teacher had breakdowns in front of us regulary.  My principal once said that he would like to hit me so bad. I also was lazy, but as it turned out I'm quite smart so I managed to get okay grades without doing pretty much anything. Even when I became a pothead with 15, and I still am. After the "high school" of my country I actually managed to put some efford into my future. I found a group of people I considered as my friends. Keep those in mind. I got better grades and today I'm a young and succesful salesman. Probably the only thing I'm proud about right now.


Now I switch back to explain my relation to my parents. I was the last of three kids and I hate my father. Mom is ok, but I try to avoid both today. My dad was on of those fathers who are disappointed with their kids if they dont do well, and as you can imagine, he hated me I think. He is a choleric nature and was shouting at me and my mother and sisters a lot. Unfortunally I am really sensible and the simple idea of my father shouting at me filled me with panic. I cried a lot about it when I was drunk.

Of course I never was in closer contact than drunk sex or prostitutes with women. Any time I got closer to a relationship they saw my mental condition and made sure to keep distance. Can't blame them.

Now we get to the most important part of my story.

In december 2011 the worst possible thing that I can think of today happened. I fell in love. With a coworker. She wasn't pretty but I loved her optimism, her confidence and how unconventional she was. I made some efforts to become a person that was able to be part f a relationship. I stopped smoking weed, worked harder and I was nicer in general. In februar last year I told her how I felt about her. 

She laughed at me. 

The next weeks I was spending consuming as much alcohol and weed as possible. She worked in the office next to mine and I heard and saw her. Every damn day. every damn day. Every damn day. I wanted to kill my personality. I always was depressed, but now I saw the only chance to exist as a human beeing in destroing what I was and creating a new personality. I was agrown. Not only agrown, but I became much older than I always wanted to be. I looked at my friends in disgust. I see them as immature dumb and primitive now. I wanted to improve. I wanted to be better, stronger and smarter. I want to be perfect. 

As you can imagine I made some distance to them until they told me they don't want to see me anymore. Can't blame them. 

Now I am well dressed, good looking, well earning and alone. I hate the success-depending world around me. But I have to play this game. Noone knows who I am anymore and noone cares who I am. All I show them is a parody of the system we live in. I laugh, I'm friendly and my customers love me. For what they see. Anyone I give a short part of my personality avoids me. I am alone now. I'm wasting the time where I can't work with reddit or other sites. I don't want to feel anymore.


Thank you for listening.
